purpose: Teach: 逆襲/脱落/総統/総督/ゆだね/波乱/バイパス/リバウンド

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、批判への逆襲は論文で示せ
lines.en: Ren — support your counterargument with the paper.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Single firm nod implicit in the rhythm. Expects compliance but not fear. The tone of someone who's made this kind of request a hundred times and sees real potential.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。同期生の脱落を防ぐ仲間意識を育てます
lines.en: Yes. I'll build stronger peer cohesion to keep classmates from dropping out.
lines.style: Straightforward commitment. No hedging. Slight lean forward — showing he's absorbed the directive. Steady eye contact. Closing syllable lands with quiet determination.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究所トップを総統に例えるな
lines.en: Ren — don't compare the lab director to a dictator.
lines.style: Flat correction, not angry. A boundary being reset. Slight pause before the name — letting it land separately. The kindness is in being clear, not ambiguous.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。植民地時代の総督研究もテーマです
lines.en: Understood. I'm also researching colonial governors as a parallel thesis.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, then pivots to his own direction. A touch of enthusiasm underneath. Not defensive — reframing his work deliberately. Small breath between the two thoughts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、後輩に研究の一部をゆだねろ
lines.en: Ren — delegate parts of your research to your juniors.
lines.style: Steady, expectant. The word 'delegate' carries slight emphasis — this is non-negotiable mentorship. No performance, just instruction delivered as an investment in his growth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験結果に波乱もありますが続けます
lines.en: Yes. The experimental data has its complications, but I'm continuing.
lines.style: Honest report, no excuse. Slight tension in 'complications' — not minimizing. Then a straightening, as if rolling shoulders. Closing with quiet persistence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文のバイパス的読み方も習得しろ
lines.en: Ren — master efficient paper-scanning technique as well.
lines.style: Another layer added. Calm, almost conversational now. Not impatient. The third or fourth instruction, delivered with the same even weight. Expects him to pace himself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。仮説のリバウンド検証もおこないます
lines.en: Understood. I'll also validate hypothesis rebound testing.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Exhale of acceptance. The meeting is closing. Ren's voice settles into a lower register — less brightness, more ground. Finality without abruptness.
